envelope.description: Move the review stream error and types to a shared module

body.title: Move the review stream error and types to a shared module
body.summary: Move ReviewStreamError and the types ReviewStreamOpts, ReviewArtifactStreamParams, CodeReviewStreamParams and CodeReviewStreamResult from src/mcp/daemon-stream.ts to src/shared/review-stream.ts; daemon-stream.ts re-exports them so its importers are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: src/shared/review-stream.ts exports the class and the four types; daemon-stream.ts re-exports them
the review and code-review routing tests pass unchanged

tests.name: review stream module: ReviewStreamError from src/shared/review-stream.ts is the same class daemon-stream.ts exports, and the routing tests pass unchanged
